description: This file contains utility functions for handling sparse images, including checking if an image is sparse and converting sparse images to raw images using external tools.

methods.name: AcquireLock
methods.description: Acquires an exclusive lock on a specified file to prevent concurrent modifications.

methods.name: IsSparseImage
methods.description: Checks if a given image file is in the Android sparse image format by reading its magic number.

methods.name: ForceRawImage
methods.description: Converts a sparse image to a raw image if it is in sparse format, using external tools and file locking.
